text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged down to 40.64 percent from 45.31 percent at the last sale on January 15, a central bank statement said on Monday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue
of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 10.00 million UAH 13.25 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.08 million UAH 11.90 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 45,000 were competitive and 55,000 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 21.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 53.31 percent from 58.86 percent at the last sale on January 14, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 10.00 million UAH 120.01 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.90 million UAH 92.78 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 10,000 were competitive and 90,000 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 21.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills fell to 57.27 percent from 60.07 percent at the last sale on January 15, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue
of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 10.00 million UAH 16.16 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.00 million UAH 11.15 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 21.
